name: dipper-worker
description: AI Worker powered by AI OS
author: Dipper

scripts.build: pnpm run clean:dist && pnpm run build:renderer && pnpm run build:electron
scripts.build:electron: pnpm run build:packages && node ./scripts/clean-dist.mjs --keep-renderer && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && node ./scripts/copy-builtin-skills.mjs
scripts.dist: pnpm run icon:rasterize && pnpm run build && node ./scripts/dist.cjs
scripts.dist:win: pnpm run icon:rasterize && pnpm run build && node ./scripts/dist.cjs --win --x64
scripts.dist:mac: pnpm run icon:rasterize && pnpm run build && node ./scripts/dist.cjs --mac --arm64
scripts.dist:linux: pnpm run icon:rasterize && pnpm run build && node ./scripts/dist.cjs --linux --x64
scripts.dist:protected:win: pnpm run icon:rasterize && pnpm run build && node ./scripts/obfuscate-electron.cjs && node ./scripts/dist.cjs --win --x64
scripts.dist:protected:mac: pnpm run icon:rasterize && pnpm run build && node ./scripts/obfuscate-electron.cjs && node ./scripts/dist.cjs --mac --arm64
scripts.dist:protected:linux: pnpm run icon:rasterize && pnpm run build && node ./scripts/obfuscate-electron.cjs && node ./scripts/dist.cjs --linux --x64
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:packages && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --noEmit
